subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu identity source should OpenClaw use for multi-bot @mention recognition when WebSocket mention `open_id` values are scoped to another app?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but choosing union_id, cross-app open_id alias mapping, app-id based matching, or another Feishu identity contract needs maintainer/API confidence because the wrong choice can still drop or misroute group messages.

options.title: Repair The Linked PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/40782 as the candidate, rewrite it on current main, and require proof that the selected identity field exists in real Feishu bot/group payloads.

options.title: Replace With Alias Mapping
options.body: Open a narrower replacement that maps known cross-app mention `open_id` variants without relying on unavailable bot `union_id` data, then close the stale PR after the replacement exists.

options.title: Document Unsupported For Now
options.body: Leave require-mention behavior unchanged and document this Feishu multi-bot limitation until a stable identity contract is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Repair The Linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/40782 as the candidate, rewrite it on current main, and require proof that the selected identity field exists in real Feishu bot/group payloads.

likelyOwner.reason: They requested changes on the linked PR and current Feishu history points to recent work on the affected identity files.
